summary: iSpecimen Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into an Asset Purchase Agreement with Foldlab AI Ltd. to acquire AI software, models, IP, and related assets, including two AI products. Total purchase price is $4.5M: $2M cash ($750K upfront, $1.25M milestone-based) and $2.5M in common stock valued by 10-day VWAP. Stock is escrowed and locked up for five years with no leak-out. No advisors named. The deal is a strategic asset acquisition; completion depends on closing conditions and milestone achievements. Watch for acceptance milestones and potential dilution from stock issuance.
